purpose: Create a separately trained, newly registered model family after historical frozen assets could not be recovered.

data_gate.required: A new immutable trajectory CSV corpus with dataset manifest, raw SHA-256 inventory, collection command/config, seed provenance, and license/approval record.
data_gate.observed_local_corpus: absent: outputs/ contains no trajectory CSV corpus
data_gate.effect: Do not train the predictor or a partial four-model family until the corpus is recorded.

acceptance: Each new asset must have its own source path, raw SHA-256, byte size, resolved config, command, seed, Git provenance, training-data manifest, run manifest, artifact contract, and review decision.
A new-source evaluation must be reported as a separate experiment and cannot satisfy the historical strict-JSBSim asset gate.
No historical asset manifest or historical checkpoint registry key may be overwritten.
